slides.texte_overlay:
Mistakes that turn a good
first date into the last one
Interrogating instead of chatting. Question after question with no stories of your own feels like a job interview. Share a little after every answer.
Showing up distracted. Earphones in, phone buzzing, mind still at work. Give the evening your full attention. Presence is the most attractive thing you can bring.
Bad-mouthing your ex. Even a short joke about them sends a warning sign. Keep the past out of tonight and focus on really getting to know her.
Drinking too fast. Two drinks in the first half hour change your energy. Slow down, sip, and stay the version of you she actually agreed to meet.
Running out of things to talk about. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a good story is always ready when the conversation slows down.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A good story is always ready when the conversation slows down.

slides.texte_overlay: Being rude when something goes wrong. A late table or a wrong order is a test. Staying calm and friendly shows her exactly who you really are.
Forgetting to ask a single question about her life. If you leave knowing nothing about her, it wasn't a date, it was a monologue. Curiosity wins.
